title: A criterion for K-injectivity in a Grothendieck abelian category
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file injectives.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma gives a criterion for a complex with injective terms to be K-injective, namely the vanishing of homotopy classes of maps from every bounded above acyclic complex of bounded cardinality (statement lines 1849-1862). The proof is a complete transfinite induction: an ordinal-indexed family of acyclic subcomplexes exhausting an arbitrary acyclic complex is constructed (proof lines 1864-1888); the vanishing of morphisms is propagated through successor ordinals using the two short exact sequences and the injectivity of the terms together with the hypothesis (proof lines 1889-1903); and at limit ordinals the complex of morphisms is identified with a limit whose transition maps are surjective, so that the Mittag-Leffler lemma for ordinals applies (proof lines 1903-1918). The non-formal content is the transfinite construction and its limit analysis. The claim is H3.
